reviews.title: What went wrong?
reviews.text: I used to love this app. But with new updates it gets worse. It used to be very simple concept and I loved it. You start your first lesson and follow the path. Now it’s very confusing. You have your ‘Continue Learning’ next to ‘Your Daily Plan’. Right after you have Course library with bunch of the lessons. Then you have  ‘Your study path’ ‘Course collection’ and bunch of the lessons again. I forgot to mention ‘My course’ all the way at the top. Since you are using AI can it be just a ‘Day Plan’. You open an app once a day and you get your assignments for the day. After you done come back tomorrow. Now it’s very confusing. Do I go to my Day plan or Study path? Maybe have another menu with course library when you can pick a lesson if you want to. Maybe let AI make a plan for the day. Speaking section is horrible. I fail every time. Literally every time. How hard it is to say ‘My name is Anna’? I use BoldVoice to improve my accent. Oh boy that app is picky. But I practice and I able to complete assignment for the day. While I still can’t pass ‘My name is Anna’ at EF Hello. Another thing is a Roleplay. Concept is great but it’s not connected to your English level. You take a first lesson when they teach you how to say ‘Hi’ and at the end of the lesson they want you to say ‘Hi. My name is Alex. I live in LA. On my free time I love to travel and I love to read.’ And all you learn is ‘Hi. How are you?’ Talking about AI. It’s great to get a feedback on your Roleplay. But to get a letter from AI just when you selected a right answer? I spent more time reading AI responses after each question than learning. It used to be one of the best app on the market. Make it user friendly and simple to understand.

reviews.title: Scam!!
reviews.text: Be aware that this app is a scam! No free trial actually available! I have been scammed 40 dollars for just wanting to see what functions it has. I was sure I checked 7 days free trial, but when I went to cancel the subscription 20 min later, I found out that I have signed up for the 3 months plan. Also within the app there was not a function to choose monthly plan, but in Apple subscription page, there are 10 ish plans with different prices to cover the same duration. A scam!
